description: Authored relational reranking prerequisite, frozen before model scoring. Development/evaluation use disjoint requirement chains. Explicit edges are the oracle, including incoming traversal, two-hop evidence, same-vocabulary distractors and unanswerable relations. Synthetic evidence does not certify production answer quality.

pages.title: REQ-ALDER-31
pages.body: Duplicate receipts must reuse the originating transaction key.

pages.title: AlderWorker
pages.body: The worker enforces the documented invariant before accepting a request.

pages.title: AlderRegression
pages.body: The regression verifies the worker rejects requests violating the invariant and accepts compliant requests.

pages.title: AlderRelease
pages.body: The release ships the worker after its regression suite passes.
